answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A ember of per-task receipts records who did what, and the basalt of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the grove is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
